name: Tera Banna Chala Hoon
overview: Aayu Mishra has spent two years chasing a single dream: passing the NEET exam, moving to Delhi, and reuniting with the person waiting for him there. Luv Chowdhary has one job—to make sure the exam gets written, no matter the cost. When their paths cross under unexpected circumstances, a carefully planned future begins to unravel. As buried emotions, painful sacrifices, and unspoken desires come to light, both young men find themselves caught between the lives they thought they wanted and the connection neither of them saw coming. What begins with a shattered dream soon turns into a journey that will change them forever.
